```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(units)
library(AOI)
library(gghighlight)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(flextable)
```

## 1. 

```{r}
eqdc <- '+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs'

# Load all US states (excluding Puerto Rico)
states <- aoi_get(state = 'all') |> 
  filter(name != "Puerto Rico") |>
  st_transform(crs = eqdc)

# Load country boundaries
countries <- aoi_get(country = c("MX", "CA", "USA")) |> 
  st_transform(crs = eqdc)
```

## 2. 

```{r}
# Read CSV from SimpleMaps and convert to sf
cities_raw <- read_csv("data/uscities.csv")

cities <- st_as_sf(
  cities_raw,
  coords = c("lng", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
) |> 
  st_transform(crs = eqdc) |> 
  filter(state_name != "Puerto Rico")
```

## 2. 

### 2.1 

```{r}
usa_border <- states |>
  st_union() |>
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities |>
  mutate(dist_to_usa_border_km = drop_units(set_units(st_distance(geometry, usa_border), "km")))

cities |>
  select(city, state_name, dist_to_usa_border_km) |>
  slice_max(dist_to_usa_border_km, n = 5) |>
  flextable()
```

### 2.2 

```{r}
state_borders <- states |>
  st_combine() |>
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities |>
  mutate(dist_to_state_border_km = drop_units(set_units(st_distance(geometry, state_borders), "km")))

cities |>
  select(city, state_name, dist_to_state_border_km) |>
  slice_max(dist_to_state_border_km, n = 5) |>
  flextable()
```

### 2.3 

```{r}
mexico <- countries |> filter(name == "Mexico") |>
  st_union() |>
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities |>
  mutate(dist_to_mexico_km = drop_units(set_units(st_distance(geometry, mexico), "km")))

cities |>
  select(city, state_name, dist_to_mexico_km) |>
  slice_max(dist_to_mexico_km, n = 5) |>
  flextable()
```

### 2.4 

```{r}
canada <- countries |> filter(name == "Canada") |>
  st_union() |>
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")

cities <- cities |>
  mutate(dist_to_canada_km = drop_units(set_units(st_distance(geometry, canada), "km")))

cities |>
  select(city, state_name, dist_to_canada_km) |>
  slice_max(dist_to_canada_km, n = 5) |>
  flextable()
```

## 3. 

### 3.1 

```{r}
largest_cities <- cities |> 
  slice_max(order_by = population, n = 10)

ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = countries, fill = NA, color = "gray60", lty = 2) +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = largest_cities, aes(size = population), color = "blue") +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = largest_cities,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Most Populous US Cities with Country and State Boundaries") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 3.2 

```{r}
farthest_border <- cities |> 
  slice_max(dist_to_usa_border_km, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist_to_usa_border_km), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Distance (km)") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest_border, color = "red", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest_border,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Distance from Cities to USA Border") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 3.3

```{r}
farthest_state <- cities |> 
  slice_max(dist_to_state_border_km, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = cities, aes(color = dist_to_state_border_km), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Distance (km)") +
  geom_sf(data = farthest_state, color = "blue", size = 2) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = farthest_state,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Distance from Cities to State Borders") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 3.4 

```{r}
cities <- cities |> 
  mutate(diff_mex_can_km = abs(dist_to_mexico_km - dist_to_canada_km))

equidistant_cities <- cities |> 
  filter(diff_mex_can_km <= 100)

top5_equidistant <- equidistant_cities |> 
  slice_max(population, n = 5)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = equidistant_cities, color = "purple", size = 1) +
  gghighlight::gghighlight(diff_mex_can_km <= 100) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top5_equidistant,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Cities ~100 km Equidistant from Mexico and Canada Borders") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 4.

### 4.1

```{r}
cities <- cities |> 
  mutate(in_border_zone = dist_to_usa_border_km <= 160)


border_zone_summary <- cities |> 
  summarise(
    cities_in_zone = sum(in_border_zone),
    population_in_zone = sum(population[in_border_zone]),
    total_population = sum(population),
    percent_in_zone = population_in_zone / total_population * 100
  )

border_zone_summary |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 2)) |> 
  flextable() |> 
  set_header_labels(
    cities_in_zone = "Cities in Zone",
    population_in_zone = "Population in Zone",
    total_population = "Total Population",
    percent_in_zone = "% of Population in Zone"
  ) |> 
  autofit()
```

According to the table, the percentage of the population in the danger zone is 54.71%. The website mentions that roughly 2/3 of the population lives in these zones, which is a bit of an overestimate, but is still plenty close to the figure they provided.

### 4.2 

```{r}
border_cities <- cities |> 
  filter(in_border_zone)

top10_danger <- border_cities |> 
  slice_max(population, n = 10)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = border_cities, aes(color = population), size = 1) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred") +
  gghighlight::gghighlight(in_border_zone) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top10_danger,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Cities within 100 Miles of the U.S. Border") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 4.3

```{r}
border_states <- states[st_intersects(states, usa_border, sparse = FALSE), ] |> 
  pull(name)

top_by_state <- border_cities |> 
  filter(state_name %in% border_states) |> 
  group_by(state_name) |> 
  slice_max(population, n = 1) |> 
  ungroup()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = border_cities, aes(color = population), size = 1) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "orange", high = "darkred") +
  gghighlight::gghighlight(in_border_zone) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = top_by_state,
    aes(label = city, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Most Populous City per State in Border Zone") +
  theme_minimal()
```
